description: This is a Java source file implementing an Android live wallpaper service that renders animated 3D wireframe cubes with user-configurable shapes and touch interaction.

classes.name: CubeWallpaper2
classes.description: Main class extending WallpaperService, responsible for creating the live wallpaper engine.

classes.name: CubeEngine
classes.description: Inner class extending WallpaperService.Engine that handles all drawing, user interaction, and shape management.

classes.name: ThreeDPoint
classes.description: Simple data class representing a 3D point with x, y, z coordinates.

classes.name: ThreeDLine
classes.description: Data class representing a line in 3D space by indices of start and end points.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of CubeEngine for rendering the wallpaper.

methods.name: readModel
methods.description: Loads the shape model (points and lines) for the cube from resources based on user preferences.

methods.name: onSharedPreferenceChanged
methods.description: Responds to changes in user preferences, such as selected shape.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets up the surface for drawing and enables touch events.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles visibility state changes to start or stop drawing.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Adjusts drawing parameters when the surface size changes.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Placeholder for setup when surface is created.

methods.name: onSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Stops drawing when the surface is destroyed.

methods.name: onOffsetsChanged
methods.description: Handles panning/offset changes of the wallpaper.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Updates touch coordinates for interaction based on user input.

methods.name: drawFrame
methods.description: Main drawing loop invoking cube rendering and scheduling next frame.

methods.name: drawCube
methods.description: Handles the rotation, projection, and rendering of the wireframe cube.

methods.name: rotateAndProjectPoints
methods.description: Performs 3D rotation transformations and projects points onto 2D screen.

methods.name: drawLines
methods.description: Draws wireframe edges between projected points.

methods.name: drawTouchPoint
methods.description: Visual indicator for user touch interaction.
